## Continuum 0.5.11

### Ready the moment you log in
- **Your phone connects right after login, and the app opens instantly.** The login screen no longer starts its own copy of Continuum (it held the connection for up to 20 seconds before you even signed in). When the phone connects, your newest photos are fetched in the background, so the Gallery shows them as soon as you open the app.
- **No more "phone isn't connected" while it is.** A connection that silently died (phone asleep, Wi-Fi hiccup) is noticed within 4 seconds instead of 20, the phone is told to reconnect at once, and the app waits for it and loads by itself. No more pressing Try Again two or three times.

### Send to your phone from anywhere
- **Right-click any file or folder → "Send to <your phone>"**, in Files, on the GNOME desktop, in KDE's Dolphin and on the Plasma desktop. One entry per connected phone, shown only while it is connected. Several files at once, videos, zips, anything.
- **Folders** are sent as one .zip, with everything inside them.
- Fixed: the Files menu didn't appear at all on newer GNOME versions (Files 47 and later).

### Reply without opening anything
- **Reply to a WhatsApp (or any) message right in the notification**: in the banner, or later in the list under the clock (GNOME), and in Plasma's notifications (KDE).
- **Replied? The notification goes away** on the computer, whether you answered from the computer or on the phone, and the chat doesn't pop up again with your own reply in it.

### Alerts from your computer on your phone
- **`continuum-ping "Needs your password" "Please come to the PC."`** puts a notification on your phone: a bold title, a short explanation and which program asked. Handy for long jobs, scripts and AI assistants that need you while you're away from the desk.

### Fixes
- **Typing into WhatsApp while mirroring no longer puts "Message" in front of your text.** WhatsApp shows its grey "Message" hint as if it were text; Continuum now recognises an empty field reliably. Holding Backspace also deletes as many characters as it should (it removed only one before), and fast typing loses no letters.
- Copying several photos in the Gallery now pastes **all of them, under the names they have on the phone**, in Files and every other app (it pasted one "Pasted image.png" before).
- The transfer button shows an **upload arrow when sending to the phone and a download arrow when receiving**, with a band running in that direction.
- Big transfers no longer **flood the notification list** with a new progress notification every second after you dismiss one. Dismissing it now hides it for that transfer.

Update both the computer and the phone to get all of this.

Google Play Protect may ask to scan the app, because it isn't from the Play Store. Tap **Scan app**, then **Install**.
